description.narrative: Shanghai Zhonggu Logistics Co., Ltd. (Zhonggu or the Company) is the second largest domestic trade multimodal container transportation company in China and is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. Zhonggu started as a container shipping company and gradually began to provide multimodal container transportation by supplementing railway and truck transportation after the containers arrive at the ports. It targets to provide door-to-door services for its customers. As of 30 June 2021, Zhonggu operated a fleet of 109 container vessels (40 owned and 69 leased). Capacity-wise, it had approximately 160,000 TEU of ship capacity and approximately 390,000 TEU of container capacity. IFC is providing a green loan package of RMB 650 million to finance the Companys purchase of new vessels and various types of containers to further enhance its capacity. The green loan package is expected to comply with the International Green Loan Principles.

The project will support Zhonggu in expanding its operations through investment in vessels and containers, which will strengthen its multimodal transportation services and dry bulk containerization. The main project-level outcomes are the positive stakeholder effects of supporting increased volume of domestic cargo transported by expanded shipping capacity, and increased inland connectivity by supporting the Companys strategic expansion of multimodal transportation. Moreover, by shifting transportation from roads to sea and rail, the project is also expected to lead to positive environmental outcomes. At the market level, the investment is expected to contribute to competitiveness by supporting private investments in the domestic shipping sector, and demonstrating the shift towards dry bulk containerization and multimodal transportation.
